ps_title: On-device Visual Perception for Light-weight Browser Agents

evaluation_matrix.target: Host/Device Local execution without cloud dependency
evaluation_matrix.current_implementation: Host-local execution (Local Ollama / Local Python Client / Local Vault)
evaluation_matrix.evidence: 0 telemetry or external API egress observed; runs completely air-gapped on client machine.

evaluation_matrix.target: Small/quantized multimodal model rather than giant cloud API
evaluation_matrix.evidence: 3B parameter compact model runs on 6GB VRAM edge GPU.

evaluation_matrix.target: Locate clickable UI elements, buttons, links, inputs
evaluation_matrix.current_implementation: SafeCandidate engine + Accessibility Tree geometry + visual crop verifier
evaluation_matrix.evidence: 100% atomic grounding on seen sites; 93.75% on held-out real web pages.

evaluation_matrix.target: Parse and operate multi-field, multi-step forms
evaluation_matrix.current_implementation: Semantic field matcher + Local Vault + deterministic value_ref filling
evaluation_matrix.evidence: 95.0% field-level accuracy; 100% scenario completion across 4 benchmark suites.

evaluation_matrix.target: Execute sequential workflows across complex DOMs
evaluation_matrix.current_implementation: State transition manager + post-condition verification + recovery
evaluation_matrix.evidence: Evaluated through 5 to 30+ steps; graceful abstention under non-recoverable state.

evaluation_matrix.target: Sub-500ms visual perception and action selection
evaluation_matrix.current_implementation: Tier-1 Fast Perception: 14.1ms mean (14.5ms p50); Tier-2 VLM Fallback: 7.24s
evaluation_matrix.evidence: Strictly satisfied for Tier-1 Fast Local Perception (82.3% of turns). Not satisfied for Tier-2 full generative VLM turns.

evaluation_matrix.target: Detect and mask PII, secrets, auth tokens before transmission
evaluation_matrix.current_implementation: Comprehensive Regex + DOM Detector + Visual Redaction Masking Engine
evaluation_matrix.evidence: 0 leaks across 10 distinct canary surfaces; verified on raw TCP wire socket inspector.

evaluation_matrix.target: Direct execution inside browser sandbox without external host runtime
evaluation_matrix.current_implementation: Host-side Python runtime with Playwright browser bridge; V2 prototype profiled
evaluation_matrix.evidence: Host-local execution demonstrated; browser-native WebGPU profiled with FastViT in ONNX Runtime Web.
